svg.title: MUSE — Conceptual explanation: how a recommendation is made and learned from
svg.text: MUSE — Conceptual explanation: how a recommendation is made and learned from
CONCEPTUAL VIEW for the presentation: only the entities in this flow are shown. Grey lines are real foreign keys (crow's foot).
Blue numbered arrows are PROCESS STEPS performed by the API and stored procedures, not relationships. This is not the complete database ERD (see MUSE_ERD_Full_Schema).

g.title: listening_history
g.text: each play: listened time, completed, skipped

g.title: steps
g.text: user picks a mood / context → a batch is stored
sp_generate_recommendations ranks songs: mood tags, audio features, preferences
user plays a song (batch_id links play → list)

g.title: lg_notes
g.text: Crow's foot = many · bar = one · circle = zero (optional)
Solid line: identifying (FK is part of the child's PK)
PK primary key · FK foreign key
UK, U1, U2: unique key (same tag = one composite key)
Blue numbered arrows: PROCESS STEPS, not foreign keys
